stem: 反贿赂和反腐败法规的主要目的是什么？

options.A: 禁止任何个人或实体向政府官员或国有企业员工支付任何有价值的东西以获取不正当的商业利益
options.B: 禁止政府高级官员将非法所得资金转换为合法资金
options.C: 为防范腐败的外国敌对势力利用非法资金干预选举
options.D: 为防止高级政治人物利用非法手段逃避纳税

stem_en: What is the primary purpose of anti-bribery and corruption regulations?

options_en.A: To prohibit the payment of anything of value by persons or entities to government officials or employees of state-owned enterprises to obtain an improper business advantage
options_en.B: To prohibit the conversion of illegally obtained money into legal money by senior government figures
options_en.C: To protect against election interference by corrupt foreign adversaries facilitated by illicit funds
options_en.D: To protect against the use of illegal means by senior political figures to avoid paying taxes
